ocr.notes: Gist present but many garbled passages, especially the opening record and middle rounds.

title.suggested: Goss and Allen Fight to a Draw at Marshfield

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted a Dublin Freeman's Journal report of Tom Allen's fight with Joe Goss at Marshfield near Cardiff, twice moved by police, which ended in a draw after 34 rounds.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Democrat. Monday Morning, April 8, 1867.' Reprinted from the Dublin Freeman's Journal of March 19.

facts.fact: Allen fought Joe Goss to a draw at Marshfield near Cardiff; police interrupted twice and the ring was moved, the fight lasting 34 rounds and 1 hour 53 minutes
Allen's right shoulder was dislocated in the 25th round against Goss, but he fought on
Allen was trained for the Goss fight at Birmingham by Ben Garrington
Allen, of Birmingham, was described as 27 years old, 5 feet 10 inches, and in the ring since 1860
Allen's early record: beat Morris Connor, Jack Gould, Bingey Rose and Jack Parkinson; beaten by Smith the Darky and Posh Price in 1862; beat Price in 1866 in 2 hours 5 minutes; also beat Isles

notes: Report says the fight was 'on Friday'; exact day not given in the clipping.
